title: checkout-api latency
body: High checkout-api tail latency is usually one of: (1) a recent deploy changing the payment-provider call path, roll back first, ask questions later; (2) connection-pool exhaustion to the orders DB, check pool saturation and bump max connections; (3) a payment provider brownout, check the provider status page and enable the degraded-checkout feature flag.

title: orders DB connection pool
body: The orders DB pool saturates at ~80 connections per replica. Symptoms: rising p99 with flat p50 and no error-rate change. Mitigation: scale checkout-api replicas down (fewer pools), not up, then raise pool max in config service.

title: generic error-rate spike
body: For sudden 5xx spikes: check the most recent deploy across all services in the request path, then upstream provider status pages, then per-AZ health.
